description: Source code implementing functions for initializing variables, arrays, and structs in an AST for a shader compiler, including functions for zero-initialization, loop-based array initialization, and AST traversal for variable initialization.

classes.name: InitializeLocalsTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser class for initializing local variables within shader code.

methods.name: AddZeroInitSequence
methods.description: Adds zero-initialization code for a given node, handling arrays, structs, and simple types.

methods.name: AddStructZeroInitSequence
methods.description: Recursively adds zero-initialization for struct members.

methods.name: AddArrayZeroInitStatementList
methods.description: Adds zero-initialization statements for array elements.

methods.name: AddArrayZeroInitForLoop
methods.description: Creates a loop to initialize array elements.

methods.name: AddArrayZeroInitSequence
methods.description: Determines whether to initialize array elements with statements or a loop.

methods.name: InsertInitCode
methods.description: Inserts initialization code for variables into the main shader body.

methods.name: CreateInitCode
methods.description: Generates initialization code sequence for a symbol.

methods.name: InitializeUninitializedLocals
methods.description: Traverses the AST to initialize local variables that are uninitialized.

methods.name: InitializeVariables
methods.description: Main function to initialize variables in the shader AST.
